label: synthetic breach scenario of a hypothetical facility on real terrain, not validated against real data; computed on the CPU at 40 m cells (the 10 m GPU run supersedes it)
notes: Three breach scenarios of a hypothetical facility (volume, hydrograph and rheology are scenario inputs with their sources in the recipe) over the 3DEP 2018 DEM block-averaged to 40 m; the benchmark report is that of the CPU device.
The first-order hydrostatic reconstruction underestimates the bed force on steep thin flows, so run-out on the steep ground is a lower bound of what the equations give; the recipe lists the limits.
